Privacy

This app is built to work with no personal data at all. This page says what stays on your device, what never leaves it, and what the website host may see.

In short: there is no account. The app collects nothing about you and keeps no record of what you read. Your settings stay on your device. There are no ads, no analytics and no tracking.

What the app does not do

  • It does not ask you to create an account or sign in.
  • It does not send your settings anywhere. They are stored in your browser or in the app on your device only. The one thing that can leave the device is a question you choose to send us (below).
  • It shows no ads and uses no analytics, crash reporting or tracking tools.
  • It does not access your location, contacts, camera, microphone or photos.
  • It sends no notifications.

What is stored on your device only

So that the app works as you expect, it keeps only your settings in your browser's storage or the app's private storage on your device: your appearance, your text sizes, and whether you have seen the tutorial. No record of what you read is kept. We cannot see any of this. Clearing your browser data, or deleting the app, removes it.

Sharing a question

When you share a question, your device's share sheet sends the link to the app or person you choose. The link contains the question's address only; nothing about you is included.

Sending us a question

"Didn't find your question?" opens a screen where you pick a kind and may type a few words. When you tap Send, exactly those two things are posted anonymously to a form run by Google on our behalf: the kind you chose and the words you typed, nothing else, no identifier, version or language. The words are not stored on your device. Google, as the form's host, may process technical data such as your IP address under its own privacy statement. Please do not include your name or anything that identifies you. If no form is configured, the button is not shown and nothing is ever sent.

Children

The app collects no data from anyone, children included.

Changes

If this page changes, the new version is published here with its date. If a feature that needs a connection is ever added, it will be explained here first.
